page.layout: One page of running text, one column, full width. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: in concilio dixisset, Constantiense concilium fuisse supra Papam: hunc ad se vocatum, Cervinus gra-uissime obiurgauit, cumque monachus respondisset, rem ipsam testari, illud concilium fuisse supra Pa-pam(nam cum exautorauit) tunc Cervinus: Non est ita, inquit: imò Papa tunc spōte cessit, addebat-que, se posse id bulla plumbata testari, atq; hunc quoq; iussit confestim è cō-cilio abire. Sub idem tem-pus venerat è Mantua Tridentum P. Paulus Ver-gerius, episcopus Iustinopolitanus, qui aliquot le-gationibus functus fuerat pro sede Romana in Ger-mania: cum uero tantum suspectus esset, ne aliqui-bus in rebus cum Lutheranis consentiret, eum ta-men reliqui duo Cardinales Legati, nec non Car-dinales Polus & Monte, & cum his Tridentinus & Pacieus voluissent ferre, ne scilicet proderent concilium non esse liberum, si Vergerium in Ger-mania notissimum reiecissent: Cervinus nunquam de stitit, donec illum eiectum uidisset. Multi ex Episcopis cum intelligerent agi de Vergerio è concilio extur-bando, constituerant ad Pontificem ea de re scribe-re, ac monere ne id fieri pateretur: quòd multi ef-sent dicturi, nō esse liberum concilii, ex quo episcopi eiicerētur: Hieronymus Vida Cremonensis, Albae epi-scopus, uir eloquentiss. literas suo & reliquorum epi-scoporum nomine iam dictauerat, id postquā resciuit

page.notes: Two horizontal rules are printed under "Tridentum P. Paulus Vergerius" and under "Albae epi-scopus" (ruled lines, not text). The first line is a fragment and continues from the previous page. The word "Mar" at the foot is the catchword, shown in the text as printed. Some letters are faint, notably "eum" in the fifth line, which may be "cum". Passages with uncertain forms are not marked, but the words "Pacieus" and "Ceruinus" are as printed, and the spelling of the name is therefore uncertain.
